title: Compressed input expanded without a size limit (php)
description: The code expands compressed data with gzuncompress. A few kilobytes of crafted input expand to gigabytes, and the expansion happens before any check can run, so the worker dies with the request in flight.
remediation: Bound the output size or stream the expansion with a byte budget, for example a streamed expansion with a byte budget.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the expansion without knowing the output size.
